items.title: 14.4.5 Low-altitude ozone (O3) (zameen ke qareeb wali ozone) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.4.5, printed page 309.

blocks.text: Ozone ek strong oxidizing agent hai. Kam concentration mein yeh toxic (zehreeli) nahi, lekin 100 parts per million (ppm) se zyada ho to toxic hai. Yeh insanon, paudon aur doosri cheezon ko nuqsan deti hai, jaise rubber, fabric dyes (kapre ke rang), aur paint ki durability (pakkapan) aur appearance (shakal).

blocks.prompt: Ozone stratosphere mein hamein bachati hai magar zameen ke qareeb nuqsan deti hai. Farq explain karein.
blocks.explanation: Stratosphere mein oonchai par ozone harmful UV radiations ko zameen tak pohnchne se pehle absorb kar leti hai. Zameen ke qareeb yeh dhoop mein NOₓ aur VOCs se banne wala secondary pollutant hai, aur strong oxidizing agent hone ki wajah se lungs, paudon, rubber, rangon aur paint ko nuqsan deti hai.

items: Low altitude ozone: strong oxidizing agent; 100 ppm se oopar toxic; insan, paude, rubber, rang aur paint ko nuqsan.
